skill.name: xhs-creator-collaboration-evaluation
skill.description: 用户提供品牌或产品、目标受众、候选小红书达人和预算时，使用蒲公英报价、粉丝画像和内容表现比较合作适配度，交付候选对照表与待确认事项。SocialDataX 支持命令查询；不预测实际成交或投放回报。
skill.summary: Compare shortlisted Xiaohongshu creators using commercial quotes, audience evidence, content performance, and budget constraints.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 39 static matches are false positives involving Markdown, legitimate authentication documentation, creator identifiers, and readable Chinese text. Separate semantic risks concern automatic execution of an unpinned npm package and forwarding payment links without destination validation. No evidence found of embedded malware, credential exfiltration, or prompt injection in the two supplied files; external package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: CLI examples automatically execute the mutable latest npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance, and obtain consent before installation or execution in a restricted environment.

remediation.issue: Balance-error instructions forward returned payment links without validating their destination.
remediation.suggestion: Validate HTTPS and an approved billing hostname before displaying payment links, or direct users to the independently verified account dashboard.

content.value_statement: Selecting creators requires comparing prices, audience fit, and content evidence across candidates. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and produces a budget-aware comparison with explicit uncertainties.
actual_capabilities: Guide commercial profile, audience profile, and content performance queries for user-supplied creators.
Resolve creator IDs from profile URLs using the documented profile lookup.
Estimate query credits before retrieving selected commercial data.
Compare quotes, audience evidence, content performance, data coverage, and budget fit.
Separate returned facts from recommendations and identify missing commercial data.
Use documented audience summaries, commercial overviews, and metric trends when needed.
limitations: Live queries require SocialDataX credentials and credits, plus working CLI dependencies or configured MCP tools.
Content performance and trends use service-defined windows, not arbitrary date ranges.
Quotes and incomplete audience data cannot establish actual sales, negotiated prices, or investment returns.
The workflow evaluates supplied candidates only and does not contact creators, place orders, or sign agreements.

use_cases.title: Shortlist Brand Partners
use_cases.description: Compare supplied creators against a product audience and campaign budget, with evidence supporting each recommendation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Comparisons
use_cases.description: Build consistent candidate comparisons that distinguish service data, agency recommendations, and unanswered questions.

use_cases.title: Screen Quotes Before Deeper Research
use_cases.description: Check commercial quotes first and reserve additional audience or performance queries for candidates that fit the budget.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate One Creator
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [creator ID] for [product], targeting [audience] with [budget]. Explain proposed queries and credit costs before proceeding, then list evidence and missing information.

prompt_templates.title: Screen a Candidate Budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen [creator IDs] against [budget] for [product]. Start with commercial quotes only and confirm query costs. Identify budget mismatches and prices needing confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Audience and Content Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [creator IDs] for [brand] and [target audience] within [budget]. Confirm selected endpoints and costs. Keep note scopes consistent and separate facts from recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Decision Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [creator IDs or profile URLs] for [campaign], [audience], and [budget]. Propose queries within [credit limit]. After approval, compare evidence, windows, missing data, and recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: manage research scope and decision uncertainty.

output_examples.input: Illustrative planning request: compare three supplied creator IDs using quotes, audience profiles, and content performance.
output: Query plan: three commercial endpoints for each of three creators.
Estimated cost: nine successful commercial calls, totaling 180 credits.
Profile resolution: unnecessary when valid creator IDs are supplied.
Next step: confirm the query scope and estimated credits before retrieval.

output_examples.input: Illustrative comparison: Creator A has a zero quote; Creator B has no commercial data. Assess both against a CNY 10,000 budget.
output: Creator A: price requires confirmation. A returned zero quote does not establish free collaboration.
Creator B: commercial data unavailable. Preserve any existing results and do not substitute ordinary profile data.
Budget assessment: neither candidate has a confirmed usable quote.
Recommendation: obtain missing commercial information before making a budget-based choice.

best_practices: Confirm candidate IDs, selected endpoints, and estimated credits before commercial queries.
Compare consistent note scopes and preserve returned dates, sample ranges, and evidence links.
Use a reviewed CLI version, keep credentials out of reports, and verify billing destinations independently.
anti_patterns: Querying every endpoint or expanding the candidate list without a confirmed need.
Treating zero quotes, missing dates, or incomplete audience distributions as complete evidence.
Inventing precise rankings or promising actual sales and investment returns from estimated metrics.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the brand or product, target audience, budget, and candidate creator IDs or profile URLs.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Live retrieval requires authorized CLI execution or access to the documented MCP tools.

faq.question: What do commercial queries cost?
faq.answer: The skill states that each successful commercial endpoint call costs 20 credits. Failed calls are free; ordinary profile resolution has separate pricing.

faq.question: Can I request any reporting period?
faq.answer: No. Performance and trend queries use service-defined windows. Reports should retain the dates and ranges returned by the service.

faq.question: Does this skill contact creators or predict sales?
faq.answer: No. It compares supplied candidates without messaging, ordering, or signing agreements, and does not predict actual sales or investment returns.

faq.question: What happens when commercial data is unavailable?
faq.answer: The workflow retains available results and marks the candidate as missing commercial data. It does not retry alternate inputs for that error.
